title: Dan Hutcheson, semiconductor industry analyst and CEO of VLSI Research holds up a 450mm silicon wafer
description:
Dan Hutcheson has been following the semiconductor industry for more than 30 years and ranks among the foremost independent authorities on chip making and the economics of innovation. In the early 1980s, he developed the first factory cost-of-ownership models, and more recently advised the White House Council of Economic Advisors on innovation.
Intel Free Press story: What's the Outlook for the Semiconductor Industry? As 22-nanometer chips reach the market, a longtime industry observer considers the state of semiconductors today and what lies ahead.
author: Intel Free Press
